description: Return a bounded monthly history for one official BTS land-border port and one consistent crossing measure from the self-hosted snapshot. Includes exact month, crossing count, stable port identity, pagination, source hash, and provenance. Use this for 'monthly truck crossings at Laredo', 'pedestrian crossings at San Ysidro since 2023', or a reproducible port-volume chart. Counts inbound crossing events, not unique vehicles or people.

measure.description: Official BTS crossing measure. Measures have different units and must not be added together.

port.description: Exact BTS four-digit port code or an unambiguous U.S. land-border port name. Search first when needed.

response_format.description: Human-readable markdown or machine-readable JSON. Default markdown.

name: bts_transport_border_trend
